d:
Full desi swag, zero tension Presenting Velly Jatt from the album Dushman, sung by Dilpreet Dhillon featuring Gurlez Akhtar, with lyrics by Narinder Batth and music by Desi Crew.
Dilpreet's bold vocals and Gurlez Akhtar's powerhouse voice come together over Desi Crew's hard-hitting beat, a full-on attitude anthem for the gym, the drive and every party
Song Credits
Title - Velly Jatt
Album - Dushman
Artist - Dilpreet Dhillon Ft Gurlej Akhtar
Lyrics - Narinder Batth
Music - Desi Crew
